text_block_list.name: Northern Children
text_block_list.text:
Tora-chaaan!
Happy New Year!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, congrats, everyone!
I brought along not just Tra-chan, but Trainy too!
—Early spring. Transcend and I decided to spend New Year's in the northern lands we frequently visit for cultural exchanges.

text_block_list.name: Northern Child A
text_block_list.text:
Tora-chan.
Your race last year was amazing!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oh, was it fun? I was totally determined
to blow everyone away in that race, you know.

text_block_list.name: Northern Child B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I was cheering at the top of my lungs!
Whenever it's race day for Tra-chan,
everyone always goes crazy!

text_block_list.name: Northern Child A
text_block_list.text: The grownups were saying that since there aren't many places to have fun around here, they're really looking forward to the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I see. Fufufu~ Well, if you ever want to blow away your boring daily routine, just leave it to me.
Right, Train-chan?
choice_data_list: Yeah, as long as it brings them some joy!
Right, as long as it brings them some joy!

text_block_list.text:
"I want to feel the thrill.
And I want to make them feel it too..."
Transcend's feelings seemed to be gradually taking shape.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Right, with that said, off to Hatsumode we go!
Let's see, as for this year's goal—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
First is completing the Cinemagun's data.
And then, based on that analyzed data...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Back-to-back Champions Cup wins!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: ...So, what d'you think?
choice_data_list: Back-to-back wins! Aiming high, huh? Nobody's ever done that before!
Back-to-back wins! Aiming high, aren't you? Nobody's ever done that before!

text_block_list.text:
"No Umamusume has ever won the major dirt race,
the Champions Cup, for two consecutive years."
"If achieved, it seemed poised to be a glorious feat that would electrify the dirt racing world."

text_block_list.name: Northern Child A
text_block_list.text: Two years in a row...? Can you really do something like that, Tora-chan?

text_block_list.name: Northern Child B
text_block_list.text: Just winning once was amazing enough...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Fufufun-fu~, Tora-chan can do anything, you know.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Trai-chan and I are gonna rule the racing world
again this year, so look forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Northern Children
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

—A solid bond. A solid friendship.
The connection between Transcend and the northern children grows ever stronger.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Now then, while we're on our New Year's visit, let me
show everyone my top-notch wish-granting merchandise.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I've got the latest one that I backed on crowdfunding.
New Year's prayers ought to be cyber-style too, you know?

text_block_list.name: Northern Children
text_block_list.text: Yay, I wanna see, I wanna see!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Right? But I brought so many,
I can't decide which one to pick. It's a bit of a dilemma.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Trai-chan, which one do you think would get
the best reaction? I want you to pick for me.

Cyber prayer charms.
Among them, the one that caught my attention the most was...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oho, the 'High-Energy Votive Plaque'!
You have quite an eye to pick that.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's start by tying it up
just like a normal ema.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: All right, that does it.

Transcend wrote her wish on the ema she brought
and hung it up.

text_block_list.name: Northern Child A
text_block_list.text: "Hey, Tora-chan. Why does that make you full of energy?"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
The main event is just getting started.
And to think, this ema is—
(Crunch, nibble, nibble...)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: It's made of cookies, so you can eat it!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's delicious!
And it's one of those eco-friendly things, right~?

text_block_list.name: Northern Child B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that looks fun.
Tora-chan, give me one too!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Of course, there's plenty for everyone~!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Just don't eat it before dinner, okay?
You'll ruin your appetite.

And so, Transcend replenished her calories
with, of all things, emergency rations.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well, I gotta get going soon.
By the way, everyone, how have things been around here lately?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oho, the 'All-Purpose Amulet'!
You have quite an eye to pick that.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
That being said, it looks pretty ordinary.
Just like any regular charm, really.
choice_data_list: How does that make it all-purpose?
How does that make it all-purpose?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Well, just watch. Here I go.
(Bloop-bloop-bloop!)

text_block_list.name: Northern Child A
text_block_list.text: Wow, the color changed!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, its blessings change like a penlight.
From exam success to traffic safety.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"I'll give one to each person.
And one for you too, Trainie."

text_block_list.name: Northern Children
text_block_list.text: Yay!

And so, thanks to the distributed transformable charms,
it felt like our luck in every aspect had improved.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well, I gotta get going soon.
By the way, everyone, how have things been around here lately?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oho, the 'Analyze Lion Dance'!
You have quite an eye to pick that.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
To put it simply, this is the
"Analyze Lion Dance" right here.

text_block_list.name: Northern Child A
text_block_list.text: Wow, how is this different from a normal lion dance?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Normally, getting bitten by a lion dancer is supposed to
ward off evil or make you smarter, but...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"What happens if I try biting Trainer-chan
with this lion dance costume, you ask~?"
(Beep!)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
See? You can tell everything about your health,
like your skin's moisture and oil levels~!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Hmm, hmm. Looks like a slight lack of vitamin E... Eating some almonds or drinking green tea should do the trick.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
See, because it can analyze like this,
it's an Analytical Lion Dance.
Now I'll examine everyone for you.

text_block_list.name: Northern Child B
text_block_list.text: Yay, chew on it, chew on it!

And so, Transcend investigated all sorts of metrics
and served as everyone's health advisor.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well, I gotta get going soon.
By the way, everyone, how have things been around here lately?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: If anything happens, like the water pipes freezing or cold drafts coming in, I'll let the volunteer group I'm close with know.

text_block_list.name: Northern Child A
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine! Ever since they fixed the hot springs, 
nothing's been wrong at all.

text_block_list.name: Northern Child B
text_block_list.text: "There's so totally nothing to do, it's almost boring~."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I see. Well, that's good. If anything comes up,
you're always OK to rely on me, alright?

text_block_list.name: Northern Child A
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. More importantly, Tora-chan,
good luck in the race!"

text_block_list.name: Northern Child B
text_block_list.text:
Because watching you race, Tora-chan,
is our favorite thing in the world!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I'll bring you tons of heart-pounding excitement this year, too. Right, Trainy?
(*whistle*)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
It makes it totally worth doing, y'know?
When they get this happy about it.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: So we're the only ones who can bring excitement to such boring days, huh? That's why...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Trai-chan.
Let's do even more this year.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
To surprise everyone even more,
first we complete the entire Cinema Gun collection! That's the plan.
Interacting with others up north in the New Year gave Transcend a renewed sense of motivation.
